title: Exploring the Landscape of Non-Equilibrium Memories with Neural Cellular Automata
notes: Combines proofs and machine learning to discover robust memory rules beyond Toom-like families.

title: A Toom rule that increases the thickness of sets
notes: Proves a monotone thickness functional for a Toom-type rule, useful as a shape-quality surrogate.

title: Universality for two-dimensional critical cellular automata
notes: Classifies critical monotone update families in 2D and proves universal threshold-order behavior.

title: Growing Neural Cellular Automata
notes: Introduces end-to-end differentiable self-organizing CA that grow and regenerate target patterns.
